pearls.purpose: The admin companion grain for the ccash constellation. Holds policy state (allowed templates, station tree, hook allowlist, manifest pins) and exposes an AdminGate over Powerbox. Operator ccash grains claim the AdminGate to read policy; admin promotions and policy changes flow back through Identity Gate. No browser UI — Powerbox-claim only.

sidecars.label: Grain Crypto Journal
sidecars.purpose: Policy state + admin journal persisted as encrypted SQLite.

sidecars.label: Grain Restore
sidecars.purpose: Cross-machine move with sealed admin keys.

sidecars.label: Identity Gate
sidecars.purpose: Every policy mutation requires a Squads-multisig-rooted Ed25519 OTP.

offers.name: ccash-admin-gate
offers.purpose: Surface configuration to peer ccash operator grains (read policy, fetch template, list allowed hooks).

offers.name: policy-attest
offers.purpose: Sign a Squads-rooted attestation that a given policy snapshot was approved at time T.

fields: Station tree YAML cache (mtime-aware re-read on each request)

adminOnly.name: Push policy update
adminOnly.purpose: Squads-signed; updates the manifest pin every ccash grain reads on next request.

adminOnly.name: Add/remove operator wallet
adminOnly.purpose: Add a wallet to the operator allowlist for the constellation.

adminOnly.name: Update station templates
adminOnly.purpose: YAML edit; mtime-aware cache invalidation pushes to all grains on next request.

blockchains.purpose: Policy attestations are Squads-vault-signed; a peer ccash grain can verify an admin-issued policy snapshot was approved by the multisig.
